year_selection: For each university, use 2025 when available; otherwise use the latest year with THPT score rows.
score_normalization: Use normalized_score when present; otherwise for THPT score > 30 use score * 30 / 40; otherwise use score.
avg_thpt_score: Average normalized THPT scores for the selected latest year of the university.
top10_variant_avg_thpt_score: For the selected latest year, build rows using the same identity as TruongDetailPage: university_program_id + non-source variant_key + variant_label + subject_group_code + gender + region_code. Keep the highest score per identity, take the 10 highest identities, then average them.
